title: Laborer — Commander, Navy Installations Command
summary: This position is located in the Fleet and Family Readiness Division at Navy Region Northwest, Naval Station Everett, Pacific Beach Resort. The purpose of this position is to perform a variety of tasks requiring moderately heavy physical effort. $20–$23 per hour

title: Cook Leader — Commander, Navy Installations Command
summary: Position is located in Pacific Beach, WA on a 47-acre property that includes 39 hotel rooms, 30 cottages, 43 RV spaces, food and bar service, gift shop and a recreation equipment rental program. Incumbent reports directly to the Naval Station Everett, WA, Morale, Welfare and Recreation Director. $26–$28 per hour
